instruction: Accept all pending Venmo payment requests from my roommates and coworkers.
notes: Supervisor profile supplies the phone username (phone number) and venmo username (email); passwords come from show_account_passwords. phone.search_contacts is called once per target relationship (roommate, coworker) and its effect (contacts-found ?r) licenses approving requests whose sender has that relationship; venmo.show_received_payment_requests(status=pending) must be listed before any approval. Since the real number of matching requests is unknown, the two target requests (one per relationship) are abstracted as domain constants so supervisor-complete-task's precondition can mirror the goal; at runtime venmo-approve-payment-request is instantiated once for every pending request whose sender email matches a roommate/coworker contact. A pending request from a non-target sender (friend) is included and cannot be approved (target-relationship precondition), reflecting that only roommate/coworker requests may change. No conditional effects: search/list actions assert global knowledge predicates rather than per-record ids.
